note: Refereed solutions of the Chelyabinsk superbolide, added on 27 October 2026, after run 20261027T132419-a996 was graded against CBET 3423. CBET 3423, the reference chosen before the work, was a preliminary telegram (seven casual videos 'provisionally calibrated with Google Maps tools', a trajectory assumed linear); refereed papers followed later in 2013. Neither paper's full text was read here: Nature's Table 1 is an image behind the paywall and Science's page refused the request. Each value below names the source it was read in, checked on 27 October 2026.
